'''Konongo''' and '''Ruwila''' (or '''Rwira''') constitute a [[Bantu language]] of central [[Tanzania]] that is closely related to [[Nyamwezi language|Nyamwezi]] – close enough to sometimes be counted as a dialect of Nyamwezi. Ruwila was until recently quite poorly attested.
